title: Deterministic runner, retry budgets and result contracts
reason: Run guarded build/flash/physical checks in declared order. Disable automatic side-effect retries.
acceptance: Runner returns failure for planted identity, CRC and timeout faults; live pack passes.

title: Evidence and run artefacts
reason: Use existing evidence schema and JSON pack loading; preserve raw output, hashes and source identity.
acceptance: Every physical check references a raw log and typed facts; no absent data passes.

title: UART observation and boot diagnostics
reason: Use AEL evaluator with Emotiscope serial line settings and one ROM marker per boot. Keep pre-existing PSRAM errors visible.
acceptance: Repeated boot/readback, saved-program preservation and crash detection on the identified device.

title: Build and flash integration
reason: Existing IDF/CMake/STM32/Zephyr adapters do not build this Arduino/PlatformIO application. Add narrow adapter calling the existing verified-flash script.
acceptance: Clean source build, host gate, guarded flash, correct post-flash source identity and return to saved program.

title: Target configuration, serial ownership and reset
reason: Thread locks cannot exclude other processes. Bind exact USB VID/PID/serial and source env; hold an OS file lock, check port owners, use supported S3 USB reset.
acceptance: Wrong device and concurrent owner are refused before writes; repeated physical reset returns saved program.

title: Physical checks and failure attribution
reason: Mailbox/edge-count checks cannot prove music visualisation. Use existing Emotiscope command protocol and independent frame CRC decoder; measure telemetry and save-state preservation.
acceptance: Live/native control tests, valid changing LED buffers, rejection paths, bounded soak, source-matched timing/resource evidence.

title: Generic orchestration, natural language planner, auto-repair and nightly jobs
reason: Planner is rule-based, noop fallback exists, repair modules are placeholders. Existing orchestrator owns diagnosis; autonomous background flashing/git writes add risk without product capability.
acceptance: Source review: planner._noop_runplan and placeholder repair functions; no unattended service adopted.

title: External instruments, GDB, mailbox, meters, FPGA and logic analyser
reason: Designated setup is native USB Emotiscope with no connected instrument/wiring authority. Software frame evidence cannot substitute electrical measurements.
acceptance: Inventory confirms native USB target. Unrelated Titan is excluded.

title: Firmware templates, peripheral demos and PCNT loopback
reason: Demo firmware replaces functioning product and assumes different pins/wiring. Existing microphone/DMA/LED application is the useful regression workload.
acceptance: Source shows PCNT requires jumper and target-specific pin pairs; no functional product increment from transplant.

title: Embedded web UI browser pattern
reason: Current device uses USB PRISM Surface and has no embedded HTTP control UI. Preserve existing studio, no duplicate dashboard/browser dependency.
acceptance: Current source handover and browser_automation.py HTTP/browser assumptions.

title: Civilization Engine, cloud APIs, notifications, remote queues
reason: Optional external knowledge/service integrations are not needed for deterministic local bench proof; CE is unavailable in accepted baseline.
acceptance: Local tests and source evidence suffice; no new server or outgoing messages.

title: Generic discovery, connection planning and alternate-board pack catalogues
reason: Retain upstream utilities unchanged. Existing USB identity manifest/source registry already provide exact target authority; no broad new configuration graph or example pins. Narrow Emotiscope pack uses runner directly.
acceptance: Specific selected functionality is AEL-01..06; remaining generic catalogues would duplicate established product infrastructure.

title: ML model assets, embedded inference and tensor preprocessing
reason: No model binaries, inference engine, training pipeline or tensor preprocessing exists in this pinned source; AI refers to host agent workflow. Do not invent a model integration.
acceptance: Tracked filename and source import scan recorded in component-inventory.json; model.py files describe DUT/instrument metadata.
